options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: name
options.description: Name to assign to your TCP check instance.

options.name: port
options.description: Port of the host to connect to.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout of the TCP query in second.

options.name: collect_response_time
options.description:
The `collect_response_time` parameter instructs the check to create a
metric 'network.tcp.response_time', tagged with the host name,
reporting the response time in seconds.

options.name: ip_cache_duration
options.description:
Time in seconds to cache the IP address of the given host. If duration is not set,
the cache will expire only upon error.

Set ip_cache_duration to `0` if the check should resolve the IP address on every check run.

options.name: multiple_ips
options.description: Enable to run the check against all IPs attached to `host`.

options.name: ipv4_only
options.description: Enable to run the check against only IPv4-formatted addresses on every check run.

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.

options.name: metric_patterns
options.description:
A mapping of metrics to include or exclude, with each entry being a regular expression.

Metrics defined in `exclude` will take precedence in case of overlap.
